facts.fact: The Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission said the Digital, Electronic, Online and Non-Traditional Consumer Lending Regulations, 2025 came into effect on 21 July 2025 and set 5 January 2026 as the deadline for full compliance, with enforcement to follow.
